subject: general
question: What is the value of Cos ( - (17pi)/(3) )
solution:
Given:

Cos ( - (17pi)/(3) )

Concept used:

1. cos (- θ) = cos θ

2. cos is always positive in the fourth quadrant.

3. sin 30° = 1/2

Calculation:

Cos ( - (17pi)/(3) )

⇒ Cos (17pi)/(3)

⇒ Cos (17times 180^circ)/(3)

⇒ Cos {17times 60^circ}

⇒ Cos 1020°

⇒ Cos ({90^circ times 11 + 30^circ})

⇒ Sin 30°

⇒ (1)/(2)

**∴ The value of Cos ( - (17pi)/(3) ) is (1)/(2).**
